full_factors: the work has several genuinely separable lenses that can be assigned without duplication
the expected value of additional independent scrutiny outweighs coordination and subscription cost
a dedicated adversarial stage is materially useful before synthesis
light_factors: the work is sequential or depends on one shared context
three provider-family perspectives cover the material lenses
the run is an exploratory, diagnostic, or pilot iteration
mode_selection.note: Light is a starting configuration, not a capability ceiling. Full remains available whenever the task structure and expected value justify it. A later follow-up panel remains a new user-triggered invocation under the review-plan non-recursion rule.

full: pre-mortem, failure recovery, and hidden dependencies
simplification, maintenance burden, and opportunity cost
outside view, alternatives, and disconfirming cases
completeness, affected users, and missing perspectives
light: implementation, reliability, and decisive failure modes
outside view, alternatives, completeness, and missing perspectives

full_host_local_synthesis.note: Full: the host family synthesizes; the adversary is drawn from the two non-host families and the synthesis fallback is the other non-host family, so a fallback never lands on the host's own (possibly scarce) subscription. Light stays on rotation until the replay bias test (replay-bias-harness.mjs) shows no material own-family promotion effect: Light has no adversarial pass, so nothing else checks the synthesizer.
full_host_local_synthesis.light_enable_requires: replay-bias-harness.mjs result recorded in the decision record

note: Local default is the starter user decision; balanced definitions come from the audited policy. No portable balanced runtime is bundled.
